value.reason: This key matches the OWASP Juice Shop CTF config (ctf.countryMapping.<challenge>.code). It maps the 'emptyUserRegistration' challenge to a country code used for CTF flag or scoreboard display, such as an ISO alpha-2 code. It is app or game metadata, not a person's government ID, contact detail, money data, health or biometric data, child data, or a secret. It is very low sensitivity. Profile is the closest fit because a country code is the kind of general descriptive attribute that category covers, but no individual's personal data is involved here.
